mission_briefing_mars_twins.text: To Mars. Spirit lands in Gusev Crater. Opportunity lands on the other side, at Meridiani Planum.
From space we can see dry riverbeds. Gusev may be an old lake. Meridiani has hematite, a mineral that often forms in water. People can't go yet, so robots go first.
Land safely, drive, take pictures and test the rocks with science tools. Each rover was built to work for 90 days.

mission_briefing_mars_twins.step: What do we hope to discover?
mission_briefing_mars_twins.text: Clues that water once flowed on Mars. Where there was water, life might once have been possible.
